subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: For Google Chat app-url Space events, should OpenClaw keep annotation-only mention gating or treat delivered Space webhook messages as implicitly mentioned when Google only sends the app @mentions?
rationale: Source review shows the remaining drop is at the mention activation boundary, but choosing implicit mention semantics versus stricter annotation parsing changes channel activation behavior and should be maintainer-owned.

options.title: Fix Annotation Detection And Diagnostics
options.body: Keep `requireMention` semantics, support the current Google Chat annotation shapes, and log actionable Space mention-gate drops.

options.title: Treat Delivered Space Events As Mentions
options.body: For service-account app-url Google Chat Spaces, bypass annotation-only mention detection because delivered events are already @mention-scoped by Google.

options.title: Consolidate With Broader Space Routing Work
options.body: Fold this into the larger Google Chat Space/thread routing backlog and keep the current `requireMention:false` workaround documented until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Fix Annotation Detection And Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep `requireMention` semantics, support the current Google Chat annotation shapes, and log actionable Space mention-gate drops.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history-backed owner for the current mention/access-policy boundary and can decide the channel activation semantics.
